# A beforeSet hook that throws leaves the value it rejected installed

## Context

Found while reviewing neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1086. `TextEmbeddingService.configSnapshot` needs a setter that validates and throws on a live config. A reactive `configSnapshot_` could not host that setter: after the throw, the rejected value is the config's value. Brain therefore carries plain accessors in a shared seam (neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1092), partly for this reason. It was first captured as a defect-note on 2026-10-17.

## The Problem

A reactive config whose `beforeSet` hook rejects by throwing keeps the rejected value. Probe on Neo 13.1.0 in Node:

```js
class Probe extends Neo.core.Base {
    static config = {className: 'Probe.ThrowingBeforeSet', foo_: null}
    beforeSetFoo(value) { if (value === 'bad') throw new TypeError('rejected'); return value }
}
Neo.setupClass(Probe);
const p = Neo.create(Probe);
p.foo = 'good';
try { p.foo = 'bad' } catch {}
p.foo // 'bad'
```

Any validation-by-throw on a reactive config is unsafe today, so consumers route around reactive configs. That is the opposite of what the class system is for.

## The Architectural Reality

- The generated setter in `src/Neo.mjs` (`autoGenerateGetSet`, dev `e0704c93bb`) works in three steps:
  - Step 2 writes the candidate to the private backing property ("Create a temporary state for beforeSet hooks"), which reaches `Config#setRaw`.
  - Step 3 reverts it ("Restore state for change detection").
  - The revert runs after the hook returns, and on the `undefined` cancel path.
- The surrounding `try` has only a `finally`, which resumes the EffectManager. A throw from `beforeSet<Key>` therefore skips both reverts, and the getter (`me[_key]` → `config.get()`) returns the candidate.
- Design authority, `src/core/Base.mjs` config-hook JSDoc: "`beforeSetMyConfig(newValue, oldValue)`: Executed before a new value is set. Can be used for validation or transformation. Returning `undefined` from this hook will cancel the update." The setter's own comments call the step-2 write a temporary state.

## The Fix

In the generated setter, when `beforeSet<Key>` throws, restore the backing property to `oldValue` and rethrow the same error. No `afterSet` runs and no subscriber is notified, matching the cancel path except that the caller sees the error.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1 A `beforeSet` that throws leaves the previous value readable, rethrows the same error, and runs no `afterSet`.
- [ ] AC-2 The cancel path (`undefined`) and the transform path are unchanged, and the existing core class-system suites stay green.
- [ ] AC-3 A unit arm in `test/playwright/unit/core/ClassSystem.spec.mjs` is red on dev and green with the fix.

## Out of Scope

- Transactional `set({a, b})`, where configs applied before a later throw stay applied. That is a separate question.
- Brain's plain accessors (neomjs/neo-agent-brain#1092). They stay valid; this fix makes a reactive slot possible again, not required.
